seo.title: Non-Clinical Healthcare Jobs - Goodwill Staffing & Recruitment
seo.description: Explore permanent healthcare careers in non-clinical roles. We connect professionals with opportunities in admin, scheduling, HR, payroll, and more.

hero.title: Explore Non-Clinical Healthcare Careers
hero.subtitle: From scheduling to HR, we connect skilled professionals like you with roles that power the entire healthcare system. Whether you’re coming from healthcare or a different industry, we’ll match your strengths to a permanent role where you’re appreciated.

blocks.text: We place permanent and direct hire candidates in

blocks.html:
⦁ Scheduling & Staffing Coordination

⦁ Administrative Assistants (clinical and corporate)

⦁ Human Resources (HR coordinators, assistants)

⦁ Payroll & Billing Professionals

⦁ Receptionists & Front Desk Staff

⦁ Office Managers

⦁ Medical Office Assistants (MOAs)

⦁ Data Entry & Records Specialists

⦁ Health Information Management Clerks

⦁ Executive Assistants (healthcare sector)

Focus on long-term placements and culture fit. Understand what healthcare employers need—and what candidates want. Support your resume, interview prep, and onboarding. Work with hospitals, clinics, private offices, and government agencies.

items.question: Do I need healthcare experience?
items.answer: Not always. Some roles are open to those with administrative or operations experience from other sectors.

items.question: Are these permanent roles?
items.answer: Yes. All non-clinical jobs listed are permanent or direct hire placements.

items.question: What types of facilities do you work with?
items.answer: We place staff in hospitals, clinics, long-term care homes, and health-focused corporate offices.

items.question: Can I apply if I’m from a different industry?
items.answer: Yes. We’ll assess your transferable skills and recommend the best matches.

blocks.html: Goodwill Staffing helps healthcare facilities find skilled professionals for non-clinical roles in admin, HR, billing, and operations. We offer full recruitment support for permanent placements.

blocks.text: Apply Now to Find a Travel Nursing Role That Fits

blocks.html: Let’s turn your skills into impact. Whether you're ready for your first contract or your fifteenth, we're here to support your journey. We respond to all qualified applicants within 1 business day.
